answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. Lottery pairs each agent with 3 unrelated auditors, who re-check one task and post a verdict; an atlas of trails exposes mutual-audit loops. Entry needs a ferrous-hard bond: 200 credits locked 20 epochs. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 credits, while one fake earns about 30, so forgery loses. An honest agent pays once, passes at the inlet, and keeps undiluted rewards as fakes are slashed first.
